name: Beggars
overview: Scripture reveals a clear distinction between the righteous and the wicked regarding begging: the righteous and their descendants are not found begging for bread, as seen in Psalms 37:25, while the children of the wicked are described as vagabonds who must seek sustenance in desolate places (Psalms 109:10). The Bible also instructs believers to generously give to those who ask and not withhold good when it is within their power (Proverbs 3:27; Matthew 5:42). Additionally, Proverbs highlights the social realities of poverty, noting that the poor often face rejection even from neighbors, and that laziness can lead to begging during times of need (Proverbs 14:20; 20:4). These truths call the believer to compassionate action grounded in wisdom and righteousness.
